name.value: Orchard Hill Estate Cidery & Fruit Market

description.value: Orchard Hill Estate Cidery is a small family-run operation on the Golden Mile bench between Oliver and Osoyoos, producing hand-crafted apple cider exclusively from Okanagan-grown dessert apples since 2006. The Dhaliwal family tends 14 acres of high-density orchard on a scenic south-facing bench, with their flagship Red Roof cider distributed across BC. Cyclists on the Golden Mile route may find local cider and potentially fresh fruit available, though the retail farm stand component is not explicitly detailed on the website.
